takes.h: Robert McCammon named Monsterama 2027 Grandmaster Guest of Honor
takes.p: Robert McCammon's official site reports he is Monsterama's 2027 Grandmaster Guest of Honor. The Atlanta-area convention runs August 6–8, 2027, at the Atlanta Marriott Northeast/Emory Hotel, with the theme “The Magic of Stop-Motion Animation.” Caroline Munro, Martine Beswick, Patrick Wayne and Kurt Christian are also named guests.
